source: NII CPS-IIP 特別警報・警報・注意報データベース (agora.ex.nii.ac.jp/cps/weather/warning/, Kitamoto; origin: 気象庁防災情報XML). Per-municipality lists warning_list.pl?acode=...
granularity: minute (issuedAt = start of that warning state; clearedAt = time it was cleared or replaced by another state, e.g. 大雪注意報->大雪警報 closes the former)
coverage: Complete paging of the NII DB (all pages fetched, counts verified against the stated total) for 札幌市 0110000 (5790 rows, 58 pages), 小樽市 0120300 (6557), 岩見沢市 0121000 (5537), 千歳市 0122400 (5592); DB goes back to 2013-02. Entries kept: issuedAt <= 2025-03-31 and clearedAt >= 2021-12-01. So all four areas are complete for 2021-12-01 -> 2025-03-31 (winters 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25). Includes all warning types (also non-snow). Entry for 2025-04-01 onward is in warnings.json.
note: Times are as shown by the NII DB (JST +09). Entries issued before 2021-12-01 are kept only if still in force on/after 2021-12-01.
